description: Assesses how readable and navigable a page is for AI agents performing 'agentic browsing' (Claude, ChatGPT agents, Perplexity, etc.), not just traditional search crawlers. Checks: llms.txt compliance, heading structure sanity, image alt-text coverage, ARIA landmarks/labels, meta robots directives, and whether AI-specific crawlers are blocked in robots.txt. Aligned with Lighthouse's new Agentic Browsing audit category.

url.description: Full URL of the page to check.

name: check_agentic_readiness
